tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session shows a Magento 1.x admin with a product grid (id convention productGrid) using canonical filter input ids (productGrid_filter_<column>) and canonical edit URL pattern /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/<id>/. The Create Product flow uses attribute_set_id and type radio, and the mass-action uses #productGrid_massaction-select and #productGrid_massaction-submit.

Task Definition:
- Single deterministic task: apply a set of grid filters (ID, sku, name, type, attribute set, price range, qty range, visibility, status, website, per_page) and then open the product edit page for a specific product id by navigating directly to the canonical edit URL. The tool does not attempt optional branching or client-side JS toggles; it uses direct DOM selectors and URL navigation for reliability.

Action Plan (detailed to-do list):
1) Navigate to the Manage Products grid URL (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/).
2) Set each available filter input using Magento's canonical selectors (IDs or well-scoped XPaths). For inputs that accept ranges, set both from/to fields where available.
3) Set select filters using visible option text (type, visibility, status, attribute set where possible).
4) Optionally set per_page if provided.
5) Click the grid Search button (scoped to the productGrid) to apply filters and wait briefly for results.
6) Navigate directly to the product edit URL for the required open_product_id: http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{open_product_id}/ (PASS 2 URL optimization). This avoids fragile row-locators and ensures the correct product page loads.
7) Wait for the edit page to load and extract a short confirmation that the edit page is present (title/heading or save button presence).

Variable Identification (inputs required):
- open_product_id (required) — product id to open for editing
- product_id_from, product_id_to, sku, name, type, attribute_set, price_from, price_to, qty_from, qty_to, visibility, status, website, per_page — all optional and map directly to grid filter inputs/controls

Step Optimization:
- Use canonical grid filter IDs (#productGrid_filter_sku, #productGrid_filter_name, #productGrid_filter_price_from/_price_to, #productGrid_filter_qty_from/_qty_to, #productGrid_filter_type, #productGrid_filter_visibility, #productGrid_filter_status, #productGrid_filter_website) to interact deterministically.
- Replace the UI click on the row Edit link with direct navigation to the known edit URL pattern to avoid brittle row-scoped selectors and ensure exactly one page is opened (PASS 2 URL manipulation).
- Keep steps linear and deterministic: input values are written even if empty (automation consumer should provide empty strings for unused filters). No conditional branching.

Assumptions and caveats:
- The agent is already authenticated; this tool does not log in.
- The Magento admin uses standard CE 1.x id/name conventions. If the admin has been extensively customized, selectors may need adjustment.
- JavaScript-dependent dynamic behaviors (AJAX massaction injection, WYSIWYG editors) are out of scope for this specific one-task tool; the tool relies on server-rendered form elements and direct URL navigation.

Essential-only policy:
- Only steps necessary for 'apply filters and open edit page' are included. No additional exploratory or optional UI flows (mass action etc.) are performed here.
name: magento_admin_find_and_open_product
description: Navigate to Magento admin product grid, apply column filters using provided technical filter parameters, run the grid search, and open the product edit page for a specified product id. Uses Magento 1.x admin DOM conventions and direct edit-page navigation for reliability.

steps.description: Open the Magento Admin Manage Products grid (starting page for applying filters).
Set the Name filter (text). If empty, this clears/keeps the field blank.
Set the SKU filter (text).
Set the ID filter 'From' field. Many Magento installs place the ID range inputs under productGrid_filter_id; provide the lower bound here (empty to skip).
Set the ID filter 'To' field. Uses a conservative selector that covers common variations for the second ID input.
Select the product Type filter. Use Magento technical option values (simple, grouped, configurable, virtual, bundle, downloadable) as visible text when appropriate.
Select Attribute Set filter. XPath covers both common id variants (productGrid_filter_set_name or productGrid_filter_set).
Set Price filter 'From' (numeric).
Set Price filter 'To' (numeric).
Set Qty filter 'From' (numeric).
Set Qty filter 'To' (numeric).
Set Visibility filter (use exact visible text, e.g. 'Catalog, Search').
Set Status filter (Enabled/Disabled).
Set Website filter (visible website name).
Set the grid 'View' / per-page control if present (20,30,50,100,200). Provide empty string to leave default.
Click the grid Search button scoped to the product grid to apply the filters.
Wait briefly for the grid to refresh after applying filters.
Open the product edit page directly for the supplied product id (deterministic URL pattern).
Wait for the product edit page to load.
Extract a short confirmation (page title and presence of Save button) to verify that the edit page loaded.
steps.goal: Confirm the product edit page loaded and capture the edit page title and presence of Save/Back controls.

input_schema.name: open_product_id
input_schema.description: Numeric product id to open for editing (used to build the canonical edit URL: /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{open_product_id}/). Example: "2796"

input_schema.name: product_id_from
input_schema.description: ID range lower bound for the grid filter (maps to the 'ID From' filter). Supply empty string to leave blank.

input_schema.name: product_id_to
input_schema.description: ID range upper bound for the grid filter (maps to the 'ID To' filter). Supply empty string to leave blank.

input_schema.name: type
input_schema.description: Product type filter. Use Magento technical values (lowercase) that correspond to grid options (simple, grouped, configurable, virtual, bundle, downloadable). Leave blank to skip.

input_schema.name: attribute_set
input_schema.description: Attribute set name (or id) to filter by. This maps to the attribute set filter (ids vary across installs).

input_schema.name: price_from
input_schema.description: Price filter lower bound (maps to #productGrid_filter_price_from). Use plain numeric string (e.g. "10.00").

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Visibility filter option text as shown in admin UI. Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Status filter option text (Enabled or Disabled). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: website
input_schema.description: Website filter visible text (e.g. 'Main Website' or specific website name). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: per_page
input_schema.description: Optional page size to set in the grid 'View' control (20,30,50,100,200). Leave blank to use default.
